entries.title: Avro Lincoln — official recognition plate
entries.configuration: Lincoln II recognition silhouettes, May 1949 plate in FM 30-30 (1954). The source explicitly states that Lincoln II is the same in appearance as Lincoln I. Four inline tractor engines, twin fins, nose/dorsal/tail turrets and the standard bomber fuselage; main landing gear retracted in the drawings.

platforms.note: Lincoln B.I uses the source-identified appearance shared with Lincoln II; this depicts the original bomber silhouette, not a later stretched maritime conversion.
